# Kalacheva School

> > Online art education platform offering comprehensive watercolor and drawing courses for adult learners, led by instructor Veronika Kalacheva and her team of experienced artists.

Kalacheva School is an online art education platform specializing in watercolor painting and drawing instruction. The school offers structured courses ranging from beginner to advanced levels, with content created by professional artists including Veronika Kalacheva, Anastasia Lobuz, and other accomplished instructors.

## Core Courses

- [Watercolor Beginning](https://kalachevaschool.com/startwatercolor): Foundational watercolor course by Anastasia Lobuz, designed for beginners learning essential watercolor techniques and painting fundamentals

## Learning Resources & Guides

- [14 Tips with Watercolor Techniques for Beginners](https://kalachevaschool.com/blog/787471): Essential watercolor techniques and practical tips for beginner painters to improve their skills and understanding of the medium

## Inspiration & Artist Profiles

- [The Top 15 Contemporary Watercolour Artists Who Will Surely Inspire You to Paint](https://kalachevaschool.com/blog/712829): Curated profiles of 15 contemporary watercolor artists showcasing diverse styles and approaches for artistic inspiration
